title: A Lease Agreement
text:
A lease agreement sets out the terms on which a tenant may use a property. It usually states the amount of rent, the length of the lease, and the notice period required before either party ends the agreement. Landlords must keep the property safe and in good repair.

Tenants are normally responsible for damage caused by their own negligence. Many leases also prohibit subletting without written consent. Breaking these terms can give the landlord the right to end the tenancy early.

questions.text: What does a lease agreement usually state?
options: the amount of rent and the length of the lease

questions.text: What are tenants normally responsible for?
options: damage caused by their own negligence

questions.text: Why might a landlord end a tenancy early?
options: the tenant breaks the terms of the lease
the tenant pays the rent on time
the property is kept in good repair

questions.text: Why would a tenant need written consent before subletting?
options: the lease prohibits subletting without it
the landlord must sign the rent receipt
the notice period has already ended

vocabulary.definition: a written contract to rent a property
a person who rents a property

paragraph_translations: የኪራይ ውል ተከራዩ ንብረቱን መጠቀም የሚችልበትን ሁኔታ ይገልጻል። በተለምዶ የኪራዩን መጠን፣ የውሉን ጊዜ እና ማንኛውም ወገን ውሉን ከማቋረጡ በፊት የሚያስፈልገውን የማስጠንቀቂያ ጊዜ ይገልጻል። አከራዮች ንብረቱን ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀና ጥሩ ሁኔታ ላይ ማቆየት አለባቸው።
ተከራዮች በራሳቸው ቸልተኝነት ለሚደርስ ጉዳት በተለምዶ ኃላፊነት አለባቸው። ብዙ የኪራይ ውሎች ደግሞ በጽሑፍ ፈቃድ ሳይሆን ንብረቱን ለሌላ ሰው ማከራየትን ይከለክላሉ። እነዚህን ሁኔታዎች መጣስ አከራዩ ውሉን ቀድሞ የማቋረጥ መብት ሊሰጠው ይችላል።
